title: Completion rate (primary education, lower secondary education, upper secondary education)
graph_title: Completion rate (primary education, lower secondary education, upper secondary education)
national_indicator_avalable: Gross intake rate in final year (primary education, lower secondary education, upper secondary education)
national_indicator_description: This indicator measures the total number of new entrants in the last grade of a given cycle, regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of the population at the official school-age of being at that level. Between 2000 and 2016, this was referred to as the completion rate.
computation_definitions: From 2000 to 2021, the official school-ages for each level were 12 years for the final year of primary education; 15 years for the final year of lower secondary education; and 18 years for the final year of upper secondary education. In the academic year 2021/2022, the reference years changed, decreasing to 11 years for the final year of primary education; from 14 years for the final year of lower secondary education; and 17 years for the final year of upper secondary education.
computation_calculations: GIR = (Number of new entrants in school year) / (Population at the official school-age for that year) * 100
other_info: Alternative measures of completion rates for specific years are available from the 2022 [Rwanda Population and Housing Census (RPHC5) - Thematic Report Educational Characteristics of the population](https://statistics.gov.rw/data-sources/censuses/Population-and-Housing-Census/fifth-population-and-housing-census-2022/rphc5-thematic-reports/rphc5-thematic-report-educational-characteristics-population), the 2024 [Integrated Household Living Conditions Survey (EICV7) - Thematic Report Education](https://statistics.gov.rw/data-sources/surveys/EICV/integrated-household-living-conditions-survey-7-eicv-7/eicv7-thematic-report-education-202324), and the [SDG 4 Country Profile for Rwanda](https://download.uis.unesco.org/SDG4/SDG4-Profile-Rwanda.pdf) compiled by UNESCO.
comments_limitations: These are statistics for the Gross Intake Rate in the final year of primary, lower secondary, and upper secondary education; due to some students dropping out after entering the final grade, they may overestimate the completion rate.
indicator_definition: Percentage of a cohort of children or young people aged 3-5 years above the intended age for the last grade of each level of education who have completed that grade.
un_custodian_agency: United Nations Education and Scientific Cultural Organisation - Institute for Statistics (UNESCO-UIS)
goal_meta_link_text: United Nations Sustainable Development Goals Metadata (PDF 4.0 MB)
source_other_info_1: This is the data source used for the years 2007 to present. Data for the years 2007-2011 may be found in the Education Statistical Yearbook 2011.
source_organisation_2: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
source_other_info_2: This is the data source used for the years 2000, 2001, 2005, and 2006.
